categories.main_business_segments: Eagon Industrial Co., Ltd. operates primarily in three segments: wood products (plywood, flooring, veneer manufacturing and sales), forestry (timber plantation and raw wood development), and energy (steam and electricity sales via cogeneration). The company also engages in timber trade and bioenergy through subsidiaries in Solomon Islands and Chile.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced plywood and flooring manufacturing technologies including film-coated plywood, eco-friendly adhesives, and high-pressure melamine (HPM) flooring. It operates cogeneration plants producing steam and electricity with wood chip fuel, enhancing energy efficiency. Research and development focus on new wood materials, eco-friendly adhesives, and product diversification such as French herringbone flooring.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction companies, distributors, and end consumers in the housing and interior sectors. The company serves domestic markets primarily in South Korea and exports to the US, Mexico, Europe, and South America. Its energy segment supplies steam and electricity to affiliated and nearby factories and the Korea Power Exchange.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations span South Korea (headquarters and manufacturing), Chile (plywood and veneer production), and the Solomon Islands (forestry and veneer manufacturing). The company leverages Chile’s FTA network for exports and Solomon Islands’ timber resources for raw material supply.
categories.supply_chain_position: Eagon operates across upstream (forestry and raw timber development), midstream (plywood and veneer manufacturing), and downstream (flooring production and energy sales) segments, integrating raw material sourcing, processing, and final product distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas forestry as a core business, developing eco-friendly and premium wood flooring products, and enhancing energy efficiency through cogeneration. R&D efforts focus on new product development, eco-friendly adhesives, and improving manufacturing productivity to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of plywood, flooring, veneer, and raw timber. The energy segment earns income from steam and electricity sales under long-term supply contracts. Export sales contribute significantly, alongside domestic direct sales via distributors and construction companies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with domestic firms like SUN&L and Seongchang Enterprise in plywood and flooring markets. It maintains a stable domestic market position due to long-standing brand recognition and competitive raw material sourcing from overseas subsidiaries. The energy segment benefits from exclusive district energy supply rights, providing a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, consolidated revenue was approximately KRW 311.6 billion, with a 5% decline from the previous year. Operating profit decreased by 53% to KRW 9.1 billion, and net loss was KRW 5.6 billion. The company has total assets of KRW 443 billion and equity of KRW 192 billion, showing stable scale but facing short-term profitability challenges due to market conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Eagon emphasizes high-quality, eco-friendly wood products with advanced manufacturing technologies and stable raw material supply from overseas plantations. Its premium flooring brands and cogeneration energy business offer differentiated value through sustainability, product innovation, and energy efficiency. The company’s long history and certifications (e.g., KS certification for plywood flooring) reinforce its market credibility.
